stories.headline: Coinbase and Better launch first crypto-backed conforming mortgage with Fannie Mae backing

key_facts.fact: Better and Coinbase launched the first token-backed conforming mortgage in the US, allowing borrowers to pledge Bitcoin or USDC as collateral for their down payment instead of liquidating crypto holdings.
key_facts.excerpt: Prospective homebuyers will be able to use the Bitcoin or USDC in their Coinbase accounts to fund their cash down payments.

key_facts.fact: The product creates two loans at closing: a standard Fannie Mae conforming mortgage on the home, and a second loan secured by pledged crypto that funds the down payment. Both share the same interest rate and amortization term with one combined monthly payment.
key_facts.excerpt: You get two loans at closing. The first is a standard Fannie Mae mortgage on the home. The second is used to fund your cash down payment, and is secured by the crypto that you pledge.

key_facts.fact: Interest rates for the crypto-backed mortgages will be 0.5 to 1.5 percentage points higher than a standard 30-year mortgage, depending on the consumer profile.
key_facts.excerpt: The rates for the crypto-backed mortgages will be higher than a standard 30-year by between half a percentage point and 1.5 percentage points.

key_facts.fact: The token-backed mortgages are free of margin calls and top-ups. If BTC drops in value, mortgage terms remain unchanged and no additional collateral is required. Liquidation of collateral is only triggered by a 60-day payment delinquency, not by market movements.
key_facts.excerpt: Token-backed mortgages would be free of margin calls and top-ups. Market movements alone never trigger liquidation. Borrowers' collateral is at risk of liquidation only in the event of a 60-day payment delinquency.

key_facts.fact: Coinbase One members approved for a loan by Better will be eligible for up to $10,000 in closing cost credits.
key_facts.excerpt: Coinbase One members will be eligible for up to $10,000 in closing cost credits.

key_facts.fact: The product aims to expand homeownership access to approximately 52 million Americans who hold crypto but previously could not get credit for those assets in mortgage underwriting without liquidating and potentially triggering capital gains taxes.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies aim to expand homeownership access to approximately 52 million Americans.

stories.headline: Stripe launches Projects, a CLI tool that lets AI agents provision services and manage credentials

key_facts.fact: Stripe launched Projects, a CLI tool that lets developers and AI coding agents provision services, generate and store credentials, and manage billing from the terminal, eliminating manual dashboard sign-ups.
key_facts.excerpt: We decided to build Stripe Projects to help agents instantly provision services from the CLI.

key_facts.fact: A single command like 'stripe projects add posthog/analytics' creates a PostHog account, gets an API key, and sets up billing automatically.
key_facts.excerpt: Simply run: $ stripe projects add posthog/analytics. And it'll create a PostHog account, get an API key, and (as needed) set up billing.

key_facts.fact: Patrick Collison framed the tool as solving the problem Andrej Karpathy identified when building MenuGen: that vibe-coding apps is fun but deploying them requires manually assembling accounts, API keys, and configurations across many services.
key_facts.excerpt: Building a modern app is a bit like assembling IKEA furniture. There are all these services, docs, API keys, configurations, dev/prod deployments.

key_facts.fact: Launch partners include hosting (Vercel, Railway), databases (Neon PostgreSQL, Supabase, Turso, PlanetScale, Chroma), auth (Clerk), analytics (PostHog), and sandbox (Runloop), with more providers coming.
key_facts.excerpt: Hosting (Vercel, Railway), databases (Neon PostgreSQL, Supabase, Turso, PlanetScale, Chroma), auth (Clerk), analytics (PostHog), and sandbox (Runloop).

key_facts.fact: Credentials are automatically generated, synced to environment variables, and changes remain auditable and repeatable. CLI commands include 'stripe projects init', 'stripe projects catalog', 'stripe projects add', and 'stripe projects upgrade'.
key_facts.excerpt: Credentials are automatically generated, synced to environment variables, and changes remain auditable and repeatable.

key_facts.fact: Stripe Projects is launching as a developer preview with open registration at projects.dev, with plans to make it available to everyone soon.
key_facts.excerpt: Projects is launching today as a developer preview. You can register for access (we'll make it available to everyone soon).
